cards.ex: We're planning to move in next month.
cards.exUz: Biz kelasi oy ko'chib o'tishni rejalashtiryapmiz.
cards.uzDef: Yangi uyga yashash uchun ko'chib kelmoq.

cards.ex: They're going to fix up the old house.
cards.exUz: Ular eski uyni ta'mirlamoqchi.
cards.uzDef: Uyni yoki binoni ta'mirlash va yaxshilash.

cards.ex: I'm ready to settle down in a quiet neighborhood.
cards.exUz: Men tinch mahalla joylashishga tayyorman.
cards.uzDef: Bir joyda uzoq vaqt yashashga qaror qilmoq.

cards.ex: It's hard to get on the property ladder these days.
cards.exUz: Hozirgi kunda mulk narvoniga chiqish qiyin.
cards.uzDef: Uy sotib olish bosqichlari, arzonidan qimmatiga o'tish.

cards.ex: Mortgage payments are killing me every month.
cards.exUz: Ipoteka to'lovlari har oy meni qiynaydi.
cards.uzDef: Uy uchun olingan kreditni oyma-oy to'lash.

cards.ex: We're saving up for our dream home.
cards.exUz: Biz orzudagi uyimiz uchun pul yig'yapmiz.
cards.uzDef: Siz doim xohlagan, ideal uy.

cards.ex: I love reading in my cosy nook by the window.
cards.exUz: Men deraza yonidagi shinam burchagimda kitob o'qishni yaxshi ko'raman.
cards.uzDef: Uyning qulay, shinam va kichik joyi.

cards.ex: The building's structural integrity is questionable.
cards.exUz: Binoning konstruktiv yaxlitligi shubhali.
cards.uzDef: Binoning barqarorligi va mustahkamligi.

cards.ex: Our house is a constant renovation project.
cards.exUz: Bizning uy doimiy ta'mirlash loyihasi.
cards.uzDef: Uyni yangilash yoki o'zgartirish bo'yicha ishlar.

cards.ex: We need to improve the curb appeal to sell the house.
cards.exUz: Uyni sotish uchun tashqi ko'rinishini yaxshilashimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Uyning ko'chadan qaraganda ko'rinishi.

cards.ex: The new park increased property values in the area.
cards.exUz: Yangi park hududdagi mulk qiymatini oshirdi.
cards.uzDef: Uyning bozordagi bahosi.

cards.ex: I'm moving out of my parents' house next month.
cards.exUz: Men kelasi oy ota-onamning uyidan ko'chib ketyapman.
cards.uzDef: Uy yoki kvartiradan boshqa joyga ko'chib o'tmoq.

cards.ex: We're having a housewarming party next weekend.
cards.exUz: Biz kelasi hafta oxirida uy to'yi qilamiz.
cards.uzDef: Yangi uyga ko'chib o'tgandan keyin tashkil qilinadigan bayram.

cards.ex: My grandparents still live in the same house.
cards.exUz: Mening bobo-buvim hamon o'sha uyda yashaydilar.
cards.uzDef: Uyda istiqomat qilmoq, yashab turmoq.

cards.ex: Most students live off-campus after their first year.
cards.exUz: Ko'pchilik talabalar birinchi yildan so'ng kampusdan tashqarida yashaydilar.
cards.uzDef: Universitet hududidan tashqarida yashash.

cards.ex: We're planning some home improvement projects this summer.
cards.exUz: Biz bu yozda uyni yaxshilash loyihalarini rejalashtiryapmiz.
cards.uzDef: Uyga qilingan yaxshilanishlar yoki ta'mirlashlar.

cards.ex: I'm having some roommate troubles right now.
cards.exUz: Menda hozir xona sherigi bilan muammolar bor.
cards.uzDef: Xona sherigi bilan kelishmovchiliklar yoki qiyinchiliklar.

cards.ex: Make sure you read the rental agreement carefully.
cards.exUz: Ijara shartnomasini diqqat bilan o'qing.
cards.uzDef: Uyni ijaraga olish shartlari ko'rsatilgan shartnoma.

cards.ex: I need to pay the rent by the end of the week.
cards.exUz: Men hafta oxirigacha ijara to'lashim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Uyning ijarasini to'lash.

cards.ex: The ad says 'utilities included,' which is great.
cards.exUz: E'londa 'kommunal xizmatlar kiritilgan' deb yozilgan, bu juda yaxshi.
cards.uzDef: Elektr, suv va gaz kabi xarajatlar ijara narxiga kiritilgan.

cards.ex: We bought a fixer-upper for a good price.
cards.exUz: Biz arzon narxga ta'mir talab uy sotib oldik.
cards.uzDef: Ta'mirlashga muhtoj bo'lgan uy.

cards.ex: I love the open floor plan in this apartment.
cards.exUz: Menga bu kvartiraning ochiq rejasi juda yoqadi.
cards.uzDef: Devorlari kam bo'lgan, keng uy rejasi.

cards.ex: The new construction must adhere to the building code.
cards.exUz: Yangi qurilish qurilish qoidalariga rioya qilishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Qurilishda rioya qilinishi kerak bo'lgan qonunlar va standartlar.

cards.ex: The store is brick and mortar, not just online.
cards.exUz: Do'kon faqat onlayn emas, balki g'isht va ohakdan qurilgan.
cards.uzDef: An'anaviy, jismoniy binolar.

cards.ex: The house has beautiful hardwood floors.
cards.exUz: Uyda chiroyli qattiq taxta pollar bor.
cards.uzDef: Qattiq yog'ochdan yasalgan pollar.

cards.ex: The beach is just a stone's throw from our house.
cards.exUz: Plyaj bizning uyimizdan tosh otim masofada.
cards.uzDef: Juda yaqin masofa.

cards.ex: They decided to put down roots in this town.
cards.exUz: Ular shu shaharda ildiz otishga qaror qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: Bir joyda uzoq vaqt yashashga qaror qilmoq.

cards.ex: We're hoping to move upmarket in a few years.
cards.exUz: Biz bir necha yildan so'ng yuqori segmentga ko'chishga umid qilamiz.
cards.uzDef: Qimmatroq va yaxshiroq uyga ko'chib o'tish.

cards.ex: Our house is on the market now.
cards.exUz: Bizning uyimiz hozir sotuvda.
cards.uzDef: Sotuvga qo'yilgan.

cards.ex: It's a bit of a tight squeeze, but we can manage.
cards.exUz: Biroz tor joy, lekin biz uddalay olamiz.
cards.uzDef: Kichik va qulay bo'lmagan joy.
